title: Specialize templates for types
description: Template specialization supplies a different implementation for a type or a family of types. You can compare ordinary values with pointer cases.

steps.description: The primary equal template compares its arguments with ==.
The full specialization handles const char* arguments. It compares character contents with strcmp.
The primary Printer template writes the supplied value.
The partial specialization handles pointer types. It checks the pointer before reading through it and provides a separate null case.
